scope: Primary-source review of LibreDWG compile-time class support states and their implications for the existing open-source comparator and DWG/DXF semantic evidence plan.

sources: LibreDWG current README/build options and documented tool-route coverage
ACadSharp issue #1195 and linked, unmerged writer work as version-scoped loss evidence
ezdxf XREF loader documentation, scoped to its import/copy helper
method.local_crosswalk: Compared LibreDWG's explicit release/debug feature gates and per-class status taxonomy with the existing exact-artifact peer intake, operation/version matrix, output loss ledger, and composed validation checkpoint in DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md.
not_performed: No LibreDWG checkout, build, binary, command, or runtime execution
No native CAD application or geometry-kernel run
No external drawing download or fixture addition
No production code, test, dependency, or CTest registration change

findings.evidence: LibreDWG documents --enable-release as disabling features not enabled in official tarballs, including unstable DWG features and unknown versions/objects; --enable-debug enables debugging classes for testing. Its class documentation distinguishes stable, unstable, debugging, and unhandled states.
findings.plan_effect: At the existing composed peer checkpoint, bind each result to the exact configure/build profile and record per-class state. Separate package/release-profile evidence from debug-enabled investigative evidence. Do not promote a feature that is present only in a debug build to ordinary released capability.

findings.topic: Per-class read/write disposition is not transitive
findings.evidence: LibreDWG documents unstable classes as sometimes emitted to DXF/JSON but not necessarily DWG; such classes can become UNKNOWN/PLACEHOLDER/DUMMY/POINT representations. Same-version persistence requires retaining the complete unknown_bits blob. Unhandled classes are ignored.
findings.plan_effect: Grade each (DWG version, object class, operation, build profile) independently as typed decode, opaque preservation, placeholder/lowering, omitted, or refused. Count same-version opaque replay only as carrier preservation; semantic support still needs typed fields, identity/owner closure, and independently authored expected values.

findings.evidence: The current README gives broad coverage language alongside route-specific caveats, including advanced R2010+ objects that may be skipped and distinct DWG/DXF converter coverage descriptions.
findings.plan_effect: Retain the plan's per-version, per-direction, per-class evidence matrix; aggregate percentage or a converter name does not substitute for a measured class-level result.

findings.evidence: ACadSharp issue #1195 reports silent omission of 3DSOLID/REGION by the specifically named 3.4.9 DWG-to-DXF writer; the maintainer says the DXF entities were unsupported and links to unmerged writer work. Separately, ezdxf documents that its XREF copy/import helper has a narrower copyable/transformable subset and ignores unsupported ACAD_TABLE/unknown entities without raising exceptions. These are version- and helper-scoped reports, not current-package reproductions or base-parser behavior.
findings.plan_effect: Reconfirm the existing end-to-end per-handle loss ledger. Grade the stage and operation actually exercised; neither process success nor a helper that returns without an exception proves source/output inventory completeness. Do not turn these reports into a new libdxfrw bug without a local reproducer.

existing_owners_only: S8/PAR-07 peer evidence intake and emitted-identity/loss ledger
required_peer_receipt_fields: immutable source revision or release artifact hash
configure/build flags and relevant dependency profile
format version, class/type, operation and requested/actual output version
per-class state: stable, unstable, debugging, or unhandled where available
typed decode, opaque blob retention, placeholder/lowering, omission or refusal disposition
source/output identity, owner, and payload evidence
independent reader/consumer and semantic result as separate outcomes
implementation_readiness.validation_cadence: No peer build/run is added to implementation slices. Resolve an already-selected comparator once at the composed checkpoint; keep focused generated local tests and the owning CTest per slice.
implementation_readiness.fixture_policy: Use in-memory or scratch-generated controls. Do not commit new external DWG/DXF test files; existing LibreCAD/libdxfrw corpus items and files created locally from scratch remain the only permitted fixture sources.
